description_text: Cape Henlopen State Park offers beautiful ocean beaches, historic pine forests, trails, and campsites on the historic Delaware bay.
campground_text: Cape Henlopen State Park campground features newly renovated campsites with water and electric hook-ups (50 and 100 amp), fire rings, picnic tables, and laundry facilities.

description_text: Delaware Seashore State Park features sandy beaches and campsites on both sides of the Indian River Inlet, with full hook-up sites and tent sites.
campground_text: Delaware Seashore State Park campground offers campsites on both the north and south sides of the Indian River Inlet, featuring full hookups (electric, water, sewer) and beach access.

description_text: Killens Pond State Park is situated around a scenic pond in central Delaware, offering a water park, boat rentals, and shaded campsites.
campground_text: Killens Pond State Park campground is located in a lovely pine-forested area, offering electric/water hookup sites, a water park, and family-friendly amenities.

description_text: Lums Pond State Park surrounds Delaware's largest freshwater pond, offering ziplines, boating, and a newly renovated campground with full hookups.
campground_text: Lums Pond State Park campground is newly upgraded to feature full hookup sites (electric, water, sewer) alongside the pond, with access to boating and zip lining.

description_text: Trap Pond State Park features the northernmost natural stand of baldcypress trees in North America, with peaceful swamp boating and wooded campsites.
campground_text: Trap Pond State Park campground is nestled under the loblolly pines, featuring electric/water hookups, pontoon boat tours, and canoe rentals.

description_text: Alapocas Run State Park is a scenic park in Wilmington featuring rock climbing, hiking trails, and beautiful canopy woodlands.
Auburn Valley State Park preserves the history of the Marshall family and the scenic Red Clay Creek valley, featuring hiking and historic steam car displays.
Bellevue State Park is the former estate of William du Pont, Jr., offering horseback riding, tennis, fishing, and beautiful walking trails.
Brandywine Creek State Park features historic stone walls, wildflower meadows, and scenic trails along the Brandywine River.
The Brandywine Zoo is located in Wilmington's Brandywine Park, featuring a variety of exotic animals and educational programs.
Fenwick Island State Park is a relaxing barrier island park offering swimming, surfing, and surf fishing along the Atlantic ocean.
First State Heritage Park is an urban park in Dover highlighting Delaware's rich history through tours and historic buildings.
Fort Delaware State Park is located on Pea Patch Island, featuring a historic Civil War fortress accessible by ferry.
Fort DuPont State Park offers views of the Delaware River, historic military fortifications, and quiet walking trails.
Fox Point State Park is a linear park along the Delaware River offering excellent views of river shipping traffic and a playground.
Holts Landing State Park is a quiet bay-side park featuring a crabbing pier, boat ramp, and scenic trails through fields and forests.
White Clay Creek State Park offers over 37 miles of trails, excellent trout fishing, and a peaceful creek valley environment.
Wilmington State Parks include Brandywine Park, Rockford Park, and H. Fletcher Brown Park, offering urban green spaces and historic monuments.
